queries: WITH station_metrics AS (SELECT t.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS station_avg, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage) SELECT lunarstage, AVG(station_avg) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, SUM(telescope_count) AS telescope_count, 1.0 * SUM(telescope_count) / (SELECT SUM(telescope_count) FROM station_metrics) AS share_of_total FROM station_metrics GROUP BY lunarstage
